question: Is EquiCSP's loss of 1:1:2:6 consensus recoveries after perovskite-framework removal specific to those structures, or would removing the same number of random structures cause it too?
model: EquiCSP, recipe of the paper's ablation/PROTOCOL.md: 106,000 optimizer steps, effective batch 256 (64 x 4 accumulation), FP32, validation-selected checkpoint; never initialised from a published checkpoint
targets: the 11 ABC2D6 targets of T180 (benchmark_deep_csp data/testsets/v3.1), 20 candidates each

arms.ABC2D6: remove the ABC2D6 family (1,551 train / 487 val), as released by the paper
arms.PEROV: ABC2D6 family plus 1,268 train / 410 val perovskite-framework structures, as released by the paper
arms.R1-R3: ABC2D6 family plus 1,268 train / 410 val drawn uniformly at random, without replacement, from the structures left after the ABC2D6 removal that are not in the PEROV lists; one draw per arm

runs.role: runner check (paper: consensus 3 of 11) and PEROV run 1

primary_metric: consensus: number of the 11 targets for which one candidate passes StructureMatcher (ltol 0.2, stol 0.3, angle_tol 5) and has the target's space group (symprec 0.1)
secondary_metric: fit: number of the 11 targets matched by at least one of the 20 candidates

decision_rules.G0_runner: Our ABC2D6 seed-42 and PEROV seed-42 runs must give consensus within 1 of the paper's 8 and 3. If either misses, stop: audit the runner before attributing anything (no further runs are spent).
decision_rules.template_specific: Supported if every R run beats every PEROV run on consensus AND mean(R) - mean(PEROV) >= 3.
decision_rules.data_amount: Supported if mean(R) - mean(PEROV) <= 1: removing the same number of random structures does about as much damage.
decision_rules.not_reproduced: If mean(PEROV) >= 6, the 8 -> 3 drop does not survive repeated seeds; report that and stop.
decision_rules.otherwise: Inconclusive. Report all runs; no further runs without a new written decision.
decision_rules.note: With 3 vs 3 runs the smallest exact one-sided permutation p-value is 1/20 = 0.05; we report counts per run and per target and do not claim more than that.

cost_gate: Before any full run: one smoke run of 1,000 steps on the rented GPU to measure time per step, then report the projected cost of all runs and wait for the owner's go-ahead.
limits: Random draws are not matched on composition or number of species to the perovskite structures; the control tests 'these structures' against 'any structures of the same count', nothing finer.
11 targets: one target is 9 percentage points.
